chunks: When Isma'il died, I ordered concerning him, while he was covered, that his face be uncovered, so I kissed his forehead, his chin, and his throat. Then I ordered concerning him and he was covered. Then I said: Uncover him, so I again kissed his forehead, his chin, and his throat. Then I ordered them, and they covered him. Then I ordered concerning him and he was washed. Then I entered upon him after he had been shrouded, and I said: Uncover his face, so I kissed his forehead, his chin, and his throat, and I sought refuge for him. Then I said: Wrap him.
Then it was said to him: By what thing did you seek refuge for him? He said: With the Qur'an.

key_terms.عَوَّذْتُهُ: I sought protection/refuge for him through recitation
key_terms.فَغُسِّلَ: then he was given ghusl (ritual washing)
key_terms.مُسَجًّى: covered over or laid out after death

ai.seo_question: What did Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام do when Isma'il died, and with what did he perform ta'widh for him?
ai.summary: This hadith narrates how Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام interacted with the body of Isma'il after his death, including uncovering his face, kissing him, and having him washed and shrouded. It also records that the Imam عليه السلام performed ta'widh for him with the Qur'an, showing funeral-related practice and familial tenderness.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications:
Hadith.449 - Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) said:
"When (my son) Ismail died, I ordered that his body, while covered, be uncovered so that I could kiss his forehead, chin, and neck.
Then, I had him covered again and later ordered that he be uncovered a second time, and I kissed his forehead, chin, and neck once more. Then, I had him covered again.
After that, I instructed that he be washed. When the washing was completed, I entered while he was being shrouded and said: 'Uncover his face,' and I kissed his forehead, chin, and neck and then recited protective supplications over him.
I then said: 'Wrap him.'
Someone asked: 'With what did you offer the protective supplication?'
Imam (as) replied: 'With the Qur'an.'"
